resolutions.researcher_notes: [Phase II, Ganzhou South Branch (Dayu-Xinfeng Segment)] CROSS-SHARD OPERATOR TENSION (filed by the coordinator, not by a research shard -- this row's own shard never saw the evidence). Batch_03 established from TWO independent documents -- the CCXI 2022 credit-rating report for 江西省天然气集团有限公司 and the quannan.gov.cn wrfz2.pdf emergency-response plan, whose own 运行单位 field names the parent Group directly -- that the 54%/46% JV (江西省天然气管道有限公司 + 国家石油天然气管网集团有限公司) operates PHASE I only (川气东送-sourced), while PHASE II (西气东输-sourced) runs under the Group's own 管道分公司 internal division with no JV/PipeChina involvement. THIS ROW IS EXPLICITLY PHASE II per its SegmentName, and its shard staged the 54/46 JV against Operator [ref]. Nine Phase II rows are in scope (P4785/P4786/P4787/P4788/P4789/P4790/P4791/P5860/P5863); batch_03's own sentinel covers P4786-P4788, so this record widens the same finding to the rows its author could not see. TWO CAVEATS, both against overreading this: (1) the staged value sits in the QCCOwner(业主单位) column -- an OWNER/proprietor-unit fact from the QCC business registry -- whereas batch_03's evidence concerns the 运行单位 (OPERATING unit). Those are different facts and the JV may well be a correct Phase II owner even if it is the wrong operator, so this is a question to adjudicate, NOT an established contradiction. (2) All nine rows are currently BLANK for Operator and Owner on the operators/owners tab (GID 1489950650, verified against the 20260902 snapshot), so nothing is at risk of being overwritten -- the only decision is which proposal, if any, gets pasted. NO value, ref, class or tier has been changed on any shard record. Recommend adjudicating the Phase I/Phase II operator split ONCE for the whole cohort rather than row by row.
